name: Aging
overview: Scripture honors aging as a time marked by wisdom and understanding, as seen in Job 12:12, and calls believers to respect and care for the elderly, exemplified in Leviticus 19:32. The Psalms express a heartfelt dependence on God's sustaining strength in old age (Psalms 71:9, 71:18) and affirm that the righteous will continue to flourish and bear witness to God's power even in advanced years (Psalms 92:12, 37:25). This teaching encourages honoring aging parents and trusting God's faithfulness throughout life's later seasons.
